Uncle Acid and the deadbeats – Shapes of Midnight

Reviews

Is Shapes Of Midnight a sign Unc needs to hang it up, or is it high time the kids get hip to a timewarp of classic metal? Uncle Acid's latest horror expands the band's signature proto-metal sound with analog synths, horns, and strong 80s metal hooks inspired by Poe’s The Masque of the Red Death.
